interpretations.summary: While not a circuit opinion per se, the enhanced FTC Safeguards Rule effective June 2023 has been interpreted more strictly in the 3rd Circuit regarding what constitutes a 'qualified individual' for information security programs at higher education institutions receiving federal financial aid.
interpretations.complianceImplication: Ensure your institution has a designated qualified individual overseeing the information security program. The 3rd Circuit has higher expectations for documentation of this role and their authority.
